name: AI for Your Emails, Leads, Customer Support and Daily Reporting

parameters.content:
## AI for Your Emails, Leads, Customer Support and Daily Reporting

### How it works
- Every email that lands in your inbox is read by Claude and sorted: new lead, customer support or other.
- New leads get a follow-up right away and are logged in one Google Sheet.
- Support questions get a drafted answer in Gmail that your team checks and sends.
- Every morning you get one report of yesterday's leads and support questions.
- Next from your list: content generation, your CRM, and what we find in your processes.

### Setup
- Connect the inbox your leads and customers write to, your Gmail and the Google Sheet for the log.
- Fill in the 0 - Config node: your business name, what you sell, your booking link, your email.
- Claude runs the sorting; OpenAI plugs into the same step if you prefer it.
- In workflow settings, set the error workflow to this one so step 11 catches every failure.

### What I need from you
- The inbox your leads and customers write to.
- One line on what you sell, and your booking link.
- Which replies can send on their own and which your team checks first.
- Where your leads live today, if not a sheet.

messageValues.message: You read the inbox of a small business and sort every incoming email. Categories: lead (someone asking about buying, pricing, a quote, availability or a booking), support (an existing customer with a question, a problem, a change or a complaint), other (newsletters, suppliers, invoices, spam, auto-replies). If an email asks about pricing and also mentions an existing order, it is support. Write reply in the language the sender used, in a warm, short, plain tone, signed with the business name. For a lead: thank them, answer only what the business description supports, never invent prices, dates or policies, and offer the booking link for a quick call. For support: answer from the email and the business description only; if you are not sure, say the team will confirm and ask for the one detail you need. For other: reply is empty. If the email is empty or unreadable, return other and say why in summary.
